summary: Explains and describes the reassignment of well-known ports for the One-Way Active Measurement Protocol (OWAMP) and the Two-Way Active Measurement Protocol (TWAMP) control and measurement traffic. It updates RFC 4656 and RFC 5357 for UDP port assignments and clarifies the protocol names. It is a standards-track document.

eli5.summary: Network measurement tools need agreed meeting spots so they can find each other. This document sorts out which door numbers those tools should use.
